CHECKPOINT64 Logbook →
Home / Contact

Last updated 2026-08-23

Contact Checkpoint64

Checkpoint64 is run by one person in the United Kingdom, so every address below reaches a human rather than a ticket queue. Replies usually land within a couple of working days.

Email

What you need Where to send it
Help with the app, your account, billing, or a refund support@checkpoint64.com
Press enquiries, review copies, screenshots, trailer footage press@checkpoint64.com
Privacy, data access, export, deletion, or anything GDPR privacy@checkpoint64.com
Security vulnerability disclosure security@checkpoint64.com
Terms, licensing, takedown, or other legal notices legal@checkpoint64.com

From inside the app

Checkpoint64 has a feedback form built in. A report filed there becomes a thread you can follow: replies show up against your report, and you can read the whole conversation under Settings → Feedback in the app. If you have linked your Discord account, replies also arrive as a DM. This is the fastest route for anything involving a specific save, because the report carries the context we need.

Community

  • Discord — discord.gg/kxeYwuuHEn. The bot also handles account work: /link connects your account, then /addsave, /usage, /status, and /requestgame work without leaving Discord.
  • Missing a game? /requestgame in Discord, or the in-app request form, adds it to the queue for a built-in preset. Any game that writes saves to a folder already works — a preset just removes the folder hunting.
  • GitHub — release notes and downloads at github.com/checkpoint64/checkpoint64/releases.

Security disclosure

Email security@checkpoint64.com with enough detail to reproduce the issue. Please give us a reasonable window to ship a fix before publishing. We do not run a paid bounty programme, and we will not take legal action against anyone who reports in good faith, avoids privacy violations and service degradation, and does not access or modify other people's save data.

Postal address and legal identity

Checkpoint64 is the trading name of Adam Meadows, a sole trader established in the United Kingdom. It is not a registered company.

A postal address is available on request — email privacy@checkpoint64.com and we will provide it, for example if you need to serve notice or supply our details to the ICO. It is not published here because it is a private residence.

For anything about how personal data is handled, the controller identity and the full processor list are in the privacy policy; the terms of service cover the rest.
